senses.en_definition: The same; alike; having no difference.
Equal in quantity, degree, or status.

collocations.en: of equal status; on an equal footing

senses.en_definition: Together with others; taking part in the same activity.
Mutually; each other; expressing a shared or reciprocal relationship.

collocations.en: both know without having to say it

senses.en_definition: To; at; introducing the person towards whom an action or feeling is directed (colloquial).

collocations.en: be angry with him or her

senses.en_definition: In sama ada: whether; in sama ada ... atau ...: whether ... or ...

messages.en: I feel like having chicken rice. What do you want to eat?
Oh, same here! I want chicken rice too. Have you ordered yet?
Not yet. I'll just order two to go. Easier that way. Want extra sambal?

senses.en_definition: Rubbish; waste material that has been discarded or is no longer wanted.
Something regarded as worthless or useless; an insulting term for a person considered contemptible.

messages.en: You're heading out, right? Could you take the rubbish out on your way? This bin's full.
Sure. Tie up that rubbish bag first, okay? I'll take it downstairs in a bit.

senses.en_definition: To arrive at a destination; to reach the intended recipient.
To achieve a goal or have a wish or intention fulfilled.
To reach a particular amount, degree, or limit; to be able to reach something.
Until; up to; marking an endpoint in time or space.
To the point that; so as to; introducing a resulting state or degree.

collocations.en: make sure you don't end up being late

messages.en: I'm at the restaurant already. Where are you?
I'm looking for a parking spot. Go on in first. Don't wait outside.
Okay, I'll wait at the table by the door.

senses.en_definition: There; over there; referring to a place distant from the speaker or regarded as distant.
That person; the other party or side, distinct from the speaker and listener (colloquial).

collocations.en: the other side; the other party
the people over there; people on the other side

messages.en: Are we meeting at that mamak place next to the bank?
Yep, see you there at eight. I'm just about to head out.
